Messages.Author: Loughman
Messages.Body:
For purposes of Leadership vacuum, one is to place X counters on it
where X is the number of votes that vampire has. What does that mean
for Prisci? Would they have the default 3 votes their sub-referendum
generates, the 1 vote they recieve in the sub-referendum or none,
since they have no intrinsic votes of their own?
